I localized the issue to [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts:68). The instance uses a boolean privacy flag that defaults to pseudonymous behavior, returns early for DNT, and accepts any truthy `posthog` config. It has no `enabled` state or `logout()`, and `identifyUser()` can call PostHog without successful initialization.

The tracking methods also fail to await the shared `capture()` call; that call silently returns before initialization. The pseudonymous path contains a misspelled enum member at [line 164](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts:164). URL redaction follows the boolean flag, so privacy state needs to be unified there too.

The fix should use `Anonymity` throughout, default to `Anonymous`, force that state under DNT while allowing valid initialization, require both config fields, gate capture on `enabled` and `initialised`, await capture, restrict identification and room events by mode, and reset PostHog on logout. One uncertainty is whether nonempty strings are required for the two config fields; the requirement says “valid” but does not define their format.

The existing [test suite](/app/test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts:32) has stale expectations: it does not await async `init()` and expects DNT to prevent initialization. Its targeted run produced **10 passes and 3 failures**. Per this run’s diagnosis-only restriction, I changed no project source or tests.

Updated [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts) to use enum based anonymity, enforce DNT, require valid configuration, gate and await event capture, restrict identification and room events, and reset PostHog on logout. Updated the focused tests.

All 21 analytics tests pass. Focused lint and `git diff --check` pass. The full TypeScript check still reports errors elsewhere in the repository, with none in `PosthogAnalytics.ts`.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts:159) changes to anonymous mode without resetting an identity previously set by `identifyUser`. Subsequent anonymous events can remain linked to that PostHog identity. Reset the client when an identified client transitions to anonymous mode, and add coverage for that transition.

**Tests:** `./node_modules/.bin/jest test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts --runInBand --silent` passed (21/21). `./node_modules/.bin/eslint --max-warnings 0 src/PosthogAnalytics.ts test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts` passed.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --jsx react` failed with repository-wide dependency and type errors, including missing `@sentry/types` and `rrweb-snapshot`. Resolve dependency compatibility before using this check as a gate.

Fixed the privacy transition in [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts): an identified PostHog client now resets before switching to anonymous mode, including when DNT forces the switch. Added transition and logout coverage in [PosthogAnalytics-test.ts](/app/test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts).

The flagged Jest check passed (23/23), and ESLint passed. **TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** the flagged TypeScript check still fails on repository-wide dependency and type errors, including missing `@sentry/types` and `rrweb-snapshot`.
